title: Advanced Digital Media Studio; Soft Modeling and Digital Fabrication
description: This course explores soft modeling, a digital sculpting approach that mimics working with clay, offering a more fluid and organic alternative to traditional CAD-based modeling. Students will develop and refine digital sculptures, preparing them for 3D printing, rendering, and other digital applications. Emphasis is placed on translating sculpted forms into both physical and virtual outputs, with a flexible approach to fabrication and visualization techniques. No prior experience required.
